biology.homeostasis-ext.0007.all: Nervous: electrical impulses along neurones, very fast, short-lived, localised (pupil reflex: light -> retina -> sensory/relay/motor neurones -> iris muscles, fast). Hormonal: chemical in blood, slower, longer lasting, widespread targets (insulin from pancreas travels in blood to liver, slower, lasting). Both involve receptors/effectors and homeostasis/negative feedback.
